- When sentiment is positive (≥0.33) in recent history, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast slightly.
- Model often overshoots after sharp price spikes (e.g., +5–10% above recent high); cap forecast at +5% of recent peak or use moving average.
- Forecast mean reverts too quickly after strong upward moves; add 1–2 lagged days of true value to dampen early momentum.
- For 30-day horizon, model consistently overpredicts late-period (last 7–10 days) prices; apply downward bias of 1–3% for final 5–7 days.
- If sentiment is neutral or negative (0.00), model shows persistent overconfidence; apply 2–4% downward adjustment to avoid overfitting to recent highs.
